name: english-dictionary-popup
description: A quiet Cambridge Dictionary companion for Firefox and Zen.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run lint:extension && npm run test:e2e
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename margin-dictionary-0.1.0.xpi --overwrite-dest
scripts.start:zen: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist --firefox /Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen
